description: TypeScript runtime for apps that people and AI agents use alike. Plugins declare collections, Actions, Views and access rules once, and the same Actions serve a web page, a terminal, the app's own agents and MCP clients such as ChatGPT and Claude, with every write on one record. Runs on Node 24+, Deno and Bun.
rules: Make every change to data an Action (defineAction) and call it from every way in: pages and tools with ctx.call, scripts with runtime.call. A tool is a thin caller of Actions; don't add a second write path.
Put access rules at the data (the shared resource or a guard), not inside Action handlers, and set allow (people, contacts, peopleOrContacts or inPerson) on every Action that outside callers use.

Test offline with a scripted model: an LlmAdapter that plays fixed moves, on memoryStore(), with await runtime.idle() before asserting. Run the tests after every change; none needs an API key or the network.
Give each agent tool a tool:<name> View that returns short text with ids the model can act on. Views and named queries read and never write; Actions write.
Throw errors meant for callers as failure(code, message, { public: true }); only a public failure's words reach an outside caller or a model.
Read who acts with personOf(ctx.actor), not ctx.actor.id (an agent's id is its own), and where with ctx.in.
Plugins reach each other only through the runtime, by name: declare requires: ["<plugin>"] and import only that plugin's contract.ts, never its code.
